instruction: Change the font size of the title 'Sample Recruitment Phone Script' to 18pt.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully removed all yellow highlights from a recruitment phone script document by selecting all text (Ctrl+A), opening the highlighting dropdown, and clicking No Fill, then saving.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select text, use toolbar formatting controls, navigate formatting options, save documents in LibreOffice Writer
metadata.task_rationale: Tests font size modification via toolbar - a related formatting skill. The model demonstrated ability to use the toolbar area, and the font size box is adjacent to the font name box it interacted with.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the title font size to 18pt. Getter reads .odt, finds the first non-empty paragraph (title), and extracts its font size. Metric checks exact match with tolerance for float/int differences.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads .odt file, builds style-to-fontsize mapping from both automatic and named styles, and extracts font size from the first non-empty paragraph (title) including span-level overrides.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_fontsize') without incorrectly nesting into 'rules'.
Expected value '18pt' matches the instruction requirement exactly.
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state.
String normalization and numeric tolerance (float comparison with 0.1 threshold) handles edge cases like '18pt' vs '18.0pt'.

Minor concern: Getter assumes first non-empty paragraph is the title without verifying text content matches 'Sample Recruitment Phone Script'. If the document has preceding content, it could check the wrong paragraph.
Minor concern: If multiple spans in the title paragraph have different font sizes, getter takes the last span's size (overwrites in loop), which may not represent the entire title's font size.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a text content check to verify the first non-empty paragraph actually contains 'Sample Recruitment Phone Script' before extracting its font size.
Consider collecting all span font sizes and verifying they are uniform, or checking the dominant font size across the entire title paragraph.
